scope: adjudicate overlapping structured-reference convergence candidates without creating another runtime implementation

observed_authority.native_profile_integrity: sha256 over stored profile_json bytes compared with profiles.profile_sha256

findings.detail: Both candidates introduce eos_pipeline_profiles/eos_pipeline_profile_components rather than reusing native entity_state.active_profile + profiles. This would create a second active-profile authority inside one MiniUnifiedDB contract.
Their local_exec subprocess.run has no explicit env mapping, so a local model runner inherits the full parent process environment, potentially including provider secrets.
Their inference pointer parser supports RFC6901-style /choices/0/message/content, consistent with the shipped v2 profile and the macrocycle's canonical unusual-experiment result.

gate_semantics: reference runtime must use the native entity_state/active_profile/profiles/profile_sha256 authority
reference runtime must not introduce eos_pipeline_profile or eos_pipeline_profiles
any subprocess.run added to the canonical reference runtime must use an explicit child env mapping

unusual_experiment.reason: The same macrocycle already consumed the single globally allowed unusual-experiment slot; this organ performs deterministic adjudication/regression work only.

runtime_execution.rerun_reason: No new execution discriminator; blind repeat of zero-step admission failures would not add evidence.

next_canonical_repair: fuse pipeline_profile_read onto native entity_state.active_profile -> profiles
verify profile_sha256 with the same stored-byte identity contract as native
retain canonical inference_generate and RFC6901 response-pointer support
retain explicit allowlisted local_exec child environment
run structured convergence plus native-authority gate on exact fresh head in authorized isolated execution
